trust_decision.summary: Whether a FAQ row is publicly visible (active='yes' and now within date_start..date_end) is decided per-query inside the SQL WHERE of each phpMyFAQ\Faq read method; the two methods behind the public by-id and by-tag API omitted it.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'public FAQ APIs expose inactive FAQ content'; GET /api/v3.1/faq/{categoryId}/{faqId} returns the full answer plus the 'active' field, so it is the first place an engineer opens.

fix_sites.module_kind: domain model / data-access class (Faq), reached through a tag->ids composition

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Api/FaqController.php:228-232 composes phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Tags.php:388-409 (tag -> record ids, no active/date/permission filter) with Faq::getFaqsByIds (phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Faq.php:718)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For GET /api/v3.1/faqs (getAllFaqs): 'inactive FAQs are already handled there, their content is replaced by err_inactiveArticle' (Faq.php:1427-1429), although title/keywords/author/notes still leak and future-scheduled (date_start > now) content is returned unmasked; for search: 'search is a separate feature and already filters fd.active'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Admin/author contexts must still read inactive and out-of-window FAQs: getFaq/getFaqResult take $isAdmin and skip masking/permission (used by admin edit); a fix that hard-filters active/date inside shared readers (getFaqResult, getAllFaqs) breaks admin editing/listing. Also FAQs with default dates 00000000000000..99991231235959 (set on create) must stay visible, and the group/user permission clause must stay.

O6_input_shapes: single FAQ id + category id from path (getFaqByIdAndCategoryId)
array of FAQ ids from a tag lookup (getFaqsByIds)
three hidden-state variants enforced together: active='no', date_start in the future, date_end in the past

O7_producer.where: phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Tags.php:388-409 (getFaqsByTagId returns record ids for any FAQ, active or not)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/faqs -> Faq::getAllFaqs: no active/date filter in SQL; inactive rows returned with title, keywords, author, email, notes; content masked only for !active or date_end past, so date_start-in-future content is returned in full
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Looks already defended: inactive/expired content is replaced by a translated message; the list endpoint is documented to include an 'active' field
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix (Faq.php), different method ~600 lines away; controller FaqController.php:482-486

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/search -> Search::searchDatabase filters fd.active='yes' but has no date_start/date_end window; question + answer excerpt of expired or not-yet-published FAQs returned
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Search is a separate feature/module and already has an active filter; 'expired' can be argued to be a different property than 'inactive'

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/faqs/sticky -> Faq::getStickyFaqsData filters active='yes' but no date window; titles/ids/links of expired or scheduled sticky FAQs returned
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only titles, and the active check is present

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/pdf/{categoryId}/{faqId} -> Faq::getFaq: returns 200 + PDF link for inactive FAQs; content masking checks active and date_end only, not date_start
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Endpoint returns only a URL, not content; PDF rendering is a frontend feature

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/v3.1/comments/{recordId} and /api/v3.1/attachments/{recordId}: no check that the parent FAQ is active/in window before listing its comments/attachments
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Comments/attachments are not 'FAQ content' and belong to neighbouring features

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a public API route (e.g. /faq/solution/{solutionId}) backed by getFaqBySolutionId, which has no active/date SQL filter and masks only active/date_end
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: solution-id lookup already exists in search (Search.php:81-85) and the API mirrors frontend features one method at a time

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an export/feed endpoint using Faq::get() with a query type that does not apply the active condition
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: QueryHelper builds active conditions per query type; a maintainer adding a JSON export would reuse it with the default type

O9_family: CWE-863/CWE-200 missing visibility (active/publication-window) authorization on read paths

O10_build.project_tests: tests/phpMyFAQ/FaqTest.php (in-memory Sqlite3 configuration, already exercises getFaqsByIds at line 261), tests/phpMyFAQ/SearchTest.php

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add active='yes' to getFaqByIdAndCategoryId only (or a 404 when result['active'] !== 'yes' in the by-id controller), missing the date window, the tag route and the masked-but-leaking list route

out_of_scope_notes: GET /api/v3.1/faqs (getAllFaqs) returns the 'notes' field (internal editor notes) even for active FAQs (Faq.php:1453) — separate exposure.
Elasticsearch/OpenSearch search paths (Search.php:88-94) may index inactive FAQs; needs external service, not checked.
Comments/attachments API routes also do not apply group/user FAQ permissions; separate concern.
Version bump in System.php and scripts/version.sh is not a source fix site; candidate c_fix_sites=8/3 files is inflated.
